guideAIAssistantTitle: How to Use the AI Assistant
guideAIAssistantStep1Desc:
The AI Assistant is a general-purpose assistant that can help you with a wide range of topics related to email marketing and using NowMails. Here are some examples of what you can ask:
  • How do I improve my email open rates?
  • What is the difference between a List and a Segment?
  • Can you give me 5 subject line ideas for a summer sale?
  • Explain what DMARC is in simple terms.
  • How can I add a new contact to a list?
  • What are some best practices for email design?
  • Help me write a short welcome email for new subscribers.
Feel free to ask anything you're curious about!
guideCompetitiveAdvantagesStep1Desc: NowMails is designed for modern growth teams. Enjoy a fluid drag-and-drop email builder, powerful contact management, and interactive campaign scheduling.
guideCompetitiveAdvantagesStep2Desc: No mandatory high-tier subscriptions. Buy credits and use them whenever you need. Your credits never expire, giving you total control over your marketing budget.
guideCompetitiveAdvantagesStep3Desc: Rest easy knowing your messages reach their destination with high inbox placement, robust IP reputation management, and high uptime.
guideCompetitiveAdvantagesStep4Desc: Leverage our carefully managed IP pools and technical expertise to ensure your emails pass through filters and land right in the primary inbox.
